ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.role: joiner for the agent-name list inside the built-in installation offer
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.tone: neutral, everyday Hindi inline enumeration; preserve names verbatim, no sentence punctuation
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.length: Two variable-width placeholders plus a comma and space for middle joins, or spaces around और for pair and final joins; wraps with the installation sentence, no fixed character limit.
ui.chat.sidebar.agents.list_join.note: Exactly two names read naturally as Coder और Reviewer, without a comma. Longer lists use a comma and space between earlier items and और before the final name, without a serial comma. Zero names produce an empty list and one name is unchanged, with no joiner call. Keep the position select and pair/middle/other arms unchanged.

placeholders.position: pair for a two-name list, middle for non-final joins, end (the other arm) for the final join of three or more names
placeholders.head: first name or the already joined preceding names; preserve verbatim
placeholders.tail: next agent display name; preserve verbatim
